name: squiggle-arrow
title: Squiggle Arrow
description: A thin hand-drawn squiggle ending in a small arrowhead, meant to point at a nearby button or field. Three waveform styles and four directions, sized by width and height.
use: You want a hand-drawn arrow to nudge attention from a note toward a button or field.
avoid: The arrow must be precise or functional: it is a decorative squiggle, not a clear directional icon.
a11y: The SVG carries a title, but as a decorative pointer it is still announced as an image called Squiggly arrow. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Thin white hand-drawn lines on black: a wavy arrow points right toward a cream Get started pill, with a tilted monospace "try it here" note before it. Below sit three more arrows, a bouncing right arrow, a smooth left arrow and a wavy downward arrow, each with a tiny grey caption.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The arrows are fixed drawings; width, height, direction and variant pick their size and shape.
customise: width, height, strokeWidth, direction (right, left, up, down) and variant (wavy, bouncy, smooth) are props; the path shapes are fixed.
weight: light: Two SVG paths; nothing animates, loads or listens.
